description: Refactor the React client from hardcoded local data to the FEAT-001 API: adopt @bowling/shared, add the API client and Vite /api proxy, introduce the LeagueContext provider, rewrite AuthContext for real JWT auth, migrate all six pages + Layout to useLeague(), add a Reports page/route, and delete client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes its endpoint contract) and on @bowling/shared being built (FEAT-001 builds it). Must land second.
steps: Add `"@bowling/shared": "*"` to client/package.json dependencies and run `npm install` at root to link it. Additively add a server.proxy block to client/vite.config.ts mapping '/api' -> { target: 'http://localhost:4000', changeOrigin: true }, keeping plugins: [react()].

Create client/src/api/client.ts per design.md: BASE_URL='/api'; getToken() reads localStorage['bowling-league.token']; request<T>() merges auth header when a token exists and, on non-OK, throws an Error carrying .status (so callers distinguish 401/403 from 5xx/network). Export read fns fetchLeague/fetchTeams/fetchTeam(id)/fetchBowlers/fetchSchedule/fetchResults/fetchLeaderboards; login(username,password); fetchMe(); writes for teams/bowlers/schedule/results (POST/PUT/DELETE), putLeagueMeta, putLeaderboards; fetchReports; uploadReport(FormData) via raw fetch (no JSON content-type, manual authHeaders); deleteReport(id); getReportUrl(id) returning the RELATIVE `${BASE_URL}/reports/${id}` = /api/reports/:id. Audit: no path passed to request() begins with /api (only getReportUrl builds a full URL).

Create client/src/data/LeagueContext.tsx exporting LeagueProvider (component) and useLeague() (hook). On mount fetch GET /api/league once via api.fetchLeague; expose { league, loading, error, getTeamById, getBowlerById, refresh } using useMemo lookup maps for O(1) getTeamById/getBowlerById. On error: error set to the message, league null, loading false. refresh re-fetches.

Rewrite client/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx keeping the { user, isAdmin, signIn, signOut } surface: signIn -> api.login, store response.token under 'bowling-league.token', set user=response.user; signOut removes the token and nulls user; on load unconditionally localStorage.removeItem('bowling-league.auth'), then if a token exists call api.fetchMe() — set user on success, clear the token ONLY on explicit 401/403, keep it on network/5xx; add an internal loading flag so refresh does not flash signed-out; isAdmin = user !== null. LoginPage.tsx must keep working unchanged.
Edit client/src/main.tsx to nest providers as <AuthProvider><LeagueProvider><App/></LeagueProvider></AuthProvider> inside the existing BrowserRouter + ThemeProvider + CssBaseline.

Migrate the five list pages (StandingsPage, SchedulePage, ScoresPage, TeamsPage, LeaderboardsPage) to read from useLeague(): replace `../data/league` imports with useLeague() and @bowling/shared type imports; add guards in order loading -> CircularProgress, error -> Alert severity="error", !league -> return null, BEFORE touching league data. Keep sx for fontWeight/fontStyle, AdjustIcon, and Grid size={{...}}.

Migrate client/src/pages/TeamDetailPage.tsx to useLeague() with the MUST-FIX guard order: loading/error/!league guards run BEFORE `const team = teamId ? getTeamById(teamId) : undefined` and the !team 'Team not found' early-return.

Edit client/src/components/Layout.tsx to use useLeague() with SILENT degrade (league?.season ?? '' etc.; no spinner or Alert in the shell) and add a { to: '/reports', label: 'Reports' } entry to navItems.

Create client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx: fetch GET /api/reports on mount, render a Table (Week, Season, Date, Filename, Size); each View action is an anchor (component="a", href={getReportUrl(report.id)}, target="_blank", rel="noreferrer"); when useAuth().isAdmin, show an upload Card (season default = league.season, week number, date, PDF-only file input) that builds FormData and calls api.uploadReport, refreshing the list on success, plus per-row Delete (window.confirm + api.deleteReport); CircularProgress while loading, Alert on error; use PageHeader like other pages. Register `<Route path="/reports" element={<ReportsPage/>} />` as a child of the existing `<Route element={<Layout/>}>` in client/src/App.tsx (do NOT wrap in a literal <Layout> element).

Delete client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts (its data was copied into server/src/seed.ts in FEAT-001). Grep client/src for any remaining `from '../types'`, `from './types'`, or `from '../data/league'` and repoint stragglers to @bowling/shared (types) or useLeague() (data).
acceptance_criteria: client/package.json lists @bowling/shared and client/vite.config.ts has an additive server.proxy for /api -> http://localhost:4000 with changeOrigin:true (plugins unchanged).

client/src/api/client.ts, client/src/data/LeagueContext.tsx (exports LeagueProvider + useLeague), and the rewritten AuthContext (bowling-league.token, fetchMe restore, 401/403-vs-5xx branch) all exist as specified.
main.tsx nests AuthProvider > LeagueProvider > App; all six pages + Layout read from useLeague() with loading/error/!league guards (TeamDetailPage guards precede the !team return).
ReportsPage exists with list + anchor View + admin upload/delete, and /reports is a child of the layout route in App.tsx.
client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts are deleted and no client/src file imports from '../types', './types', or '../data/league'.
`npm run build --workspace=client` (tsc -b && vite build) exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors.
verification: `npm run build --workspace=client` — tsc -b && vite build exit 0 with zero TS errors (shared already built in FEAT-001).
`npm run build` (root) — shared -> server -> client all exit 0.

If Atlas is reachable: start the server and `npm run dev:client`, load the SPA, confirm pages render from the API, sign-in works, and the Reports page lists/uploads. ATLAS CONTINGENCY: report DB-dependent runtime checks as blocked if the cluster refuses the connection; builds/type-checks must still pass.
findings:
FEAT-002 complete. Client refactored from hardcoded local data to the FEAT-001 API; `npm run build --workspace=client` (tsc -b && vite build) exits 0 with zero TS errors, and root `npm run build` (shared -> server -> client) is green.

WHAT CHANGED:
- client/package.json: added "@bowling/shared": "*"; `npm install` at root links it (hoisted to node_modules/@bowling/shared -> ../../shared). client/vite.config.ts: additively added server.proxy '/api' -> { target: 'http://localhost:4000', changeOrigin: true } with plugins:[react()] unchanged.
- client/src/api/client.ts (NEW): BASE_URL='/api'; getToken/setToken/clearToken on key 'bowling-league.token'; request<T>() merges Content-Type JSON + Bearer, throws ApiError carrying .status on non-OK (and returns undefined for 204). All read/write fns use /api-relative paths (audited: no request() path begins with /api). getReportUrl returns RELATIVE `${BASE_URL}/reports/${id}` = /api/reports/:id. uploadReport uses raw fetch with FormData + manual authHeaders (no JSON Content-Type).
- client/src/data/LeagueContext.tsx (NEW): exports LeagueProvider + useLeague; fetches GET /api/league once on mount; { league, loading, error, getTeamById, getBowlerById, refresh } with useMemo O(1) lookup maps; on error -> error set, league null, loading false; refresh re-fetches.
- client/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx (REWRITE): kept { user, isAdmin, signIn, signOut }; signIn -> api.login + setToken + setUser(response.user); signOut clears token + nulls user; on load unconditionally removes legacy 'bowling-league.auth', then if a token exists calls fetchMe, clearing the token ONLY on 401/403 and keeping it on network/5xx; internal loading flag avoids signed-out flash; isAdmin = user!==null.
- client/src/main.tsx: nests <AuthProvider><LeagueProvider><App/></LeagueProvider></AuthProvider> inside BrowserRouter + ThemeProvider + CssBaseline.
- Five list pages (Standings, Schedule, Scores, Teams, Leaderboards) migrated to useLeague() with guard order loading -> CircularProgress, error -> Alert severity=error, !league -> return null, before touching league data. Kept sx for fontWeight/fontStyle, AdjustIcon, Grid size={{...}}.
- TeamDetailPage: loading/error/!league guards run BEFORE `const team = teamId ? getTeamById(teamId) : undefined` and the !team return.
- Layout.tsx: useLeague() silent degrade (league?.season ?? '' in AppBar title, drawer, and footer; week uses ?? ''); added { to: '/reports', label: 'Reports' } to navItems.
- client/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx (NEW): fetches GET /api/reports on mount; Table (Week, Season, Date, Filename, Size, Actions); View action is an anchor (component=a, href=getReportUrl(id), target=_blank, rel=noreferrer); admin-only upload Card (season defaults to league.season, week number, date, PDF-only hidden file input via Button component=label) building FormData -> api.uploadReport then refresh; per-row Delete (window.confirm + api.deleteReport) when isAdmin; CircularProgress while loading, Alert on error; PageHeader like other pages.
- App.tsx: registered <Route path="/reports" element={<ReportsPage/>} /> as a child of the existing <Route element={<Layout/>}> layout route (NOT a literal <Layout> wrapper).
- Deleted client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts. Grep confirms zero remaining imports from '../types', './types', or '../data/league' in client/src.

FIX NOTE: initial client build failed once on ReportsPage — MUI v9 Stack rejects a bare justifyContent prop; moved it into sx={{ justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}. Rebuilt green.

ATLAS CONTINGENCY: the optional runtime SPA check (start server + dev:client, verify pages render from the API / sign-in / reports upload) was NOT performed in this step — it requires a live Atlas connection and a running backend. Per the contingency it is reported as not-run rather than passed. The required builds/type-checks both pass. No git repo exists; nothing committed.
